key_idea: No flow is needed: simulate day by day, since people left at an airport simply accumulate and every flight must be full, the only question is whether each airport has enough people each day.
sketch: Keep have[a] = people currently at airport a. On day d add that day's home arrivals, subtract the capacities of all flights departing a on day d, and fail if any count goes negative; passengers landing on day d are added only after the check, because a customer takes at most one flight per day. O(n*(m+k)). Pitfall: adding landed passengers before checking same-day departures lets them fly twice in a day.
